        ORG     40000

        LD      BC,1000
MLOOP   PUSH    BC
AGAIN   CALL    RANDOM
        LD      A,H
        AND     #1F
        LD      B,A
        LD      A,L
        AND     #1F
        LD      L,A
        LD      H,#58
        LD      DE,32
        LD      A,B
        CP      24
        JR      NC,AGAIN
        AND     A
        JR      Z,ZERO
LOOP    ADD     HL,DE
        DJNZ    LOOP
ZERO    LD      (HL),#FF
        POP     BC
        DEC     BC
        LD      A,B
        OR      C
        JR      NZ,MLOOP
        RET

RANDOM  PUSH    BC
        PUSH    DE
        LD      HL,(SEED)
        INC     HL
        LD      D,0
        LD      A,H
        OR      L
        JR      NZ,NOCARRY
        INC     D
NOCARRY PUSH    DE
        PUSH    HL
        SLA     L
        RL      H
        RL      D
        ADD     HL,BC
        ADC     A,D
        LD      D,A
        POP     BC
        POP     AF
        ADD     HL,BC
        ADC     A,D
        LD      C,A
        LD      B,0
        OR      A
        SBC     HL,BC
        ADC     HL,BC
        OR      A
        SBC     HL,BC
        DEC     HL
        LD      (SEED),HL
        POP     DE
        POP     BC
        RET
SEED    DEFW    0
